title: Core Java
intro: Core Java interview questions are the foundation of every Java backend interview. This page covers the language fundamentals interviewers actually probe — exception handling (checked vs unchecked, try-with-resources), generics and type erasure, reflection, the Java I/O and NIO APIs, string immutability, and the small comparisons that recur in every loop (== vs equals, Comparable vs Comparator, abstract class vs interface). For pure object-oriented design questions (encapsulation, polymorphism, SOLID applied to Java) head to the dedicated Java OOP page. Each answer is structured the way you would actually answer in a 45-minute interview: the headline, the why, a code-shaped example, and the trade-off the interviewer is really listening for.
